name: Fathom
summary: AI meeting recorder, transcriber and note-taker.
description: Fathom records, transcribes and summarizes Zoom, Google Meet and Teams meetings, and syncs notes and action items to CRMs. It is known for a generous free-forever plan for individuals. Paid plans add advanced AI summaries, team sharing, coaching and CRM integrations.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: It is known for a generous free-forever plan for individuals. Paid plans add advanced AI summaries, team sharing, coaching and CRM integrations.

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.description: Create a Fathom account. The homepage says it summarizes your meetings so you can focus on the conversation, and that a free plan is available.

howToUse.title: Capture the meeting
howToUse.description: Take notes with a meeting bot or bot-free. The site says Fathom works where you meet.

howToUse.title: Open the summary
howToUse.description: The homepage says AI summaries are available immediately after the call.

howToUse.title: Use the notes
howToUse.description: The page says your meeting data can also be used inside ChatGPT, Claude, and more.
